answer: The bond is keyed to a hardware root, so one device cannot back two identities. Registrations pass a single wharf: one device, one bond, one identity. Panels come from a rotating pool, and a bond is voided when the panel that graded it was not diverse enough to matter. A comet of signups from one device shows as one root with reused keys, and the haven of clones collapses to a single account.
